steps.what: Show the stored target for this material or equipment.
Develop fuel cell materials or test equipment on the bench.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the target already written for this material or this test equipment. The fuel cell engineer develops the material or the equipment on the bench. The target does not make it. A target with no id leaves the development with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Development started against a target that named a different material.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored target can be opened. The development still happens on the bench.
tasks.still_hard: A property the target does not mention still has to be worked by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer develops the material or the equipment. The target is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: Development stays on the bench. The stored target is visible and is not the material.

reach.task: State the target property before development starts.
reach.learn: A target title is not the material.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored target is a lookup. It does not develop a material or a piece of test equipment.
Bench development is physical work. The target does not do it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The target id already stored. The target text is not extended by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the target in the document store before asking for a second copy.
unknowns: Whether material targets and equipment targets share one record type.
research_questions: Who marks a target as the one for this development?

already_counted.description: Developing the material or the equipment stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop targets whose material record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still develops the material or the test equipment on the bench. Only opening a target that was already written is removed. A target with no id saves none of the development.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored drawing for this prototype.
Fabricate prototypes of components, stacks, or assemblies.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the drawing already stored for this prototype. The fuel cell engineer fabricates the component, assembly, stack, or system on the bench. The drawing does not build the part. A drawing with no part id leaves the fabrication with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A stack was built from a drawing that belonged to a different assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored drawing can be opened. The prototype still has to be fabricated.
tasks.still_hard: A fit the drawing does not settle still has to be made on the bench.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer fabricates the prototype. The drawing is the record already stored.
tasks.altitude: Fabrication stays on the bench. The drawing is visible and is not the part.

reach.task: Issue the drawing for the part that is about to be built.
reach.learn: A drawing title is not the prototype.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored drawing is a lookup. It does not fabricate a component, a stack, or an assembly.
Fabrication is physical work on the bench. The drawing does not build the part.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The drawing id and the part id, both already stored. The drawing is not altered by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the drawing in the document store before asking for a second copy.
unknowns: Whether stacks and single components share one drawing record.
research_questions: Who links a drawing to the part id being built?

already_counted.description: Fabricating the prototype stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop drawings whose part record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still fabricates the component, assembly, stack, or system on the bench. Only opening a drawing that was already stored is removed. A drawing with no part id saves none of the fabrication.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show stored ratings for the cells, storage units, and drives.
Manage hybrid system architecture, including component sizing.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows ratings already stored for the cells, the storage units, or the electric drives. The fuel cell engineer manages the hybrid architecture and decides the sizing. A missing rating is not replaced with a guess. Only the architecture the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A drive was sized from a rating that belonged to a different storage unit.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored ratings can be opened. The architecture and the sizing still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A duty the ratings do not cover still has to be sized by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer manages the architecture and decides the size. The rating is the number already stored.
tasks.altitude: Architecture and sizing stay with the engineer. The record is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Use an architecture the fuel cell engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A stored rating is not the sizing decision.

evidence.claim: Opening stored ratings is a lookup. It does not size a cell, a storage unit, or a drive, and it does not manage the architecture.
Filing an architecture before the engineer accepts that version would store a size nobody chose.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The component id and the rating already stored for that component. A missing rating is not filled in. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the rating in the document store before the sizing conversation. Do not type a second rating.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the fuel cell engineer.
unknowns: Whether cell, storage, and drive ratings share one record type.
research_questions: Who enters the rating that the sizing is allowed to use?

already_counted.description: Managing the architecture and deciding the size stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop ratings whose component record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: component ids, ratings used, and the sizing sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still manages the hybrid architecture and still decides the sizing. Only opening ratings that were already stored, and filing the architecture already accepted, is removed. A missing rating saves none of that decision.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the last stored testing or development program.
Design or implement fuel cell testing and development programs.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the last testing or development program already stored. The fuel cell engineer designs or implements the program for this cell. The old program is not the new one. Only the program the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: An old program was reused, and it still named tests this cell does not run.
tasks.enabler_now: The last program can be opened. The new program still has to be designed by the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A test the last program does not mention still has to be added by the engineer, or left out on purpose.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer designs or implements the program. The last program is the record already stored.
tasks.altitude: The program stays with the engineer. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Run a program the fuel cell engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: The last program is not the new program.

evidence.claim: Opening the last program is a lookup. It does not design or implement the testing or development program.
Filing a program before the engineer accepts that version would store a test plan nobody wrote.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The program id already stored. The new program text is not copied forward as accepted. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the last program in the document store before writing the new one.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the fuel cell engineer.
unknowns: Whether testing programs and development programs share one record type.
research_questions: Who marks a program as the last accepted one for this cell?

already_counted.description: Designing or implementing the program stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop programs whose cell record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: cell id and the program text the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still designs or implements the testing or development program. Only opening the last program already stored, and filing the program already accepted, is removed. The old program saves none of the new design.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The fuel cell engineer still develops the material, still fabricates the prototype, still sizes the hybrid system, and still writes the test program. A stored drawing can be opened. It does not build the part.
reach: Fabrication staff use a drawing, and this job learns the drawing is not the prototype.
Controls engineers read an accepted architecture, and this job learns a stored rating is not the sizing decision.
skills_to_grow: Develop the material or the equipment on the bench.
Fabricate the prototype from the drawing, not from the title.
Size the hybrid system only after the stored rating is checked, and leave a missing rating open.
role.ambitious_version: Development, fabrication, architecture, and test programs stay with the engineer. Stored targets and drawings only show what was already recorded.
